capabilities: convert typed LaTeX commands into Unicode symbols
insert the conversion results into the active note
run the conversion from the LaTeX to Unicode command prompt
extras: Bundles the unicodeit library, including its licenses and source code, in a unicodeit directory.
intentEvidence: Obsidian supports LaTeX, but there are cases where Unicode symbols suffice.
problem: Obsidian supports LaTeX math, but in cases where a plain Unicode symbol suffices, users must otherwise look up and type the character themselves.

relations.evidence: This plugin is based on unicodeit, specifically this GitHub repository.

summary: Converter plugin that turns LaTeX commands into Unicode symbol sequences via a command and pop-up input box.
